title: Phishing basics
body:
Phishing tricks people into giving access. Signs: urgency, a lookalike domain (halcyon-c0rp.com), a link whose real address differs from the text, unexpected attachments, requests for passwords.

Defenders: check the real sender domain, hover links, never log in from an email link, and use MFA and mail filters.

How to spot it: compare the sender domain letter by letter (0 for o, rn for m), read where a link really goes, and ask whether the message pushes you to act fast or to skip the normal process. In a SOC shift, each of these is a clue.
